title: Ozma of Oz by L. Frank Baum (1985) Illustrated: John R. Neill Dover Publications
descriptionText: Ozma of Oz by L. Frank Baum, illustrated by John R. Neill, is a classic piece of juvenile fiction published by Dover Publications in 1985. This trade paperback edition is part of the Dover Children's Series and features a reprint of the original work. With 272 pages filled with fantasy, magic, and adventure, this book is a must-read for fans of the Wizard of Oz series. The colorful illustrations by Neill bring the story to life, making this edition a captivating addition to any bookshelf.
